_format: The one place landmark ids, names and positions live. at = [x, z] centre of the place; radius_m = the area that counts as the place; anchor = [x, y, z] a point on open ground inside it (navigation tests path between anchors, and the ground views look from them). Loot clusters (data/loot.json) and later the bots refer to a landmark by id.

rules._route_note: A route is the baked navmesh path between two landmarks' anchors, sampled every route_sample_step_m. A sample has cover when anything at least cover_min_height_m tall stands within cover_reach_m of it. max_open_stretch_m is the longest run of samples without cover that a route may have.
